verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (with Octave increment ops, but primarily MATLAB-style script)
verdict.provenance_detail: Research script from StabFem project comparing analytical (Maple) and numerical (FreeFem++) solutions for critical electric field in asymmetric emitter-collector geometry
verdict.purpose: Script to retrieve and compare analytical (Maple) and numerical (FreeFem++) solutions for the critical electric field (Phic) in an asymmetric two-emitter one-collector configuration as a function of the asymmetry parameter DeltaH
